title: Mouse wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- left ear -->
    <circle cx='26' cy='30' r='14' fill='#8a8f98'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='30' r='8' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
    <!-- right ear -->
    <circle cx='74' cy='30' r='14' fill='#8a8f98'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='30' r='8' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#a9aeb8'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='36' cy='66' r='7' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='66' r='7' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
    <!-- sunglasses lenses -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#2a2e3a'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#2a2e3a'/>
    <!-- lens shine -->
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='47' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#5d6b8c'/>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='47' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#5d6b8c'/>
    <!-- glasses frame -->
    <rect x='50' y='47' width='2' height='5' fill='#d9b45a'/>
    <rect x='22' y='46' width='6' height='7' rx='2' fill='#d9b45a'/>
    <rect x='72' y='46' width='6' height='7' rx='2' fill='#d9b45a'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f27ba0'/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d='M50 66 Q44 72 50 74 Q56 72 50 66' fill='#f27ba0'/>
    <!-- whiskers -->
    <line x1='18' y1='58' x2='32' y2='60' stroke='#d7dbe2' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='17' y1='66' x2='32' y2='66' stroke='#d7dbe2' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='60' x2='82' y2='58' stroke='#d7dbe2' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='66' x2='83' y2='66' stroke='#d7dbe2' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
